34: There is none else beside Him: This is mentioned for on account of Rabbi Chanina (since he was just mentioned above).
Even sorcery is not beside Him, meaning to say, without His will. For if there is no decree upon a man, evil cannot be done to him.
Try: She was trying and applying herself that he not [notice].
To take dust and to do sorcery to him and to kill him.
Keshafim: It is an anagram: Makchishim pamaliya shel maalah (Contradicting the retinue of the Above). As they did not decree about this man, that he should die through sorcery.
